title: Home Teleport
description: Modern Lightweight Simple Home plugin with cooldown, sounds, and full config support.
body:
# 🏠 JcHome

**MINECRAFT VERSION** : 1.21+

**PLATFORM** : PAPER/SPIGOT

**AUTHOR** : JUST_CHILL

**_______________________________________________________________________________**

# ✨ What is JcHome?
JcHome is a **lightweight, stylish,** and **fully customizable** home system plugin for Minecraft servers.
With just a few **simple commands**, players can **set** and **teleport to their homes** — enhanced with **delays, cooldowns, particles**, and **sounds** for a polished experience.


**_______________________________________________________________________________**
# 💎 Features

**🏡 Set & Teleport** — Easy-to-use **/sethome** and **/home** commands

**🚚 Delete and Help** — Easy to use **/delhome** and **/helphome** commands

**⏳ Delay & Cooldown** — Balanced gameplay experience

**💨 Particles & Sounds** — Fancy effects when teleporting

**⚙️ Customizable Config** — Edit messages, timings, and limits

**🌍 Multi-World Support** — Works across all worlds

**💾 Data Stored in Config** — Simple and transparent


**_______________________________________________________________________________**

# 🧩 Config Example

```
teleportDelay: 5
cooldownSeconds: 30
maxHomes: 5
messages:
  homeSet: '&aHome set successfully!'
  teleportStart: '&eTeleporting in &65 &eseconds...'
  teleportSuccess: '&aWelcome home!'
  teleportCancelled: '&cTeleport cancelled because you moved!'
```
